title: Text: DET Lloyd McClendon ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Heard everyone is coming back except ██████, who is retiring. Do you know how they are moving people around? Off record
K...let me know, I think they are announcing tomorrow
I’m glad it turned out like this. I thought you might get scapegoated. I think bench coach is a great spot and you’ll be able to freelance, too.
Gardy was very smart in how he went about keeping you guys, I thought. I’ll give you a ring sometime before I leave for vacation next week. Thanks for being accessible.
